# Fixture provenance

`mainnet_accounts.json`, `mainnet_trade.json`, and
`mainnet_candidate_accounts.json` are public read-only Solana mainnet RPC captures
from 2026-09-16. They contain no credentials and no fabricated wallet performance.
The successful trade is a **sell**, not our portfolio entry. The later account
snapshot is not the transaction's contemporaneous pre-state; tests never pretend
it reproduces that earlier fill. These captures validate decoding, owners, PDA
identity, fee schedule and integer quote behavior only.

`synthetic_lifecycle.jsonl` is generated by `python -m tests.make_tape`. Its prices,
wallets, trades and outcomes are synthetic. It exercises the same engine and ledger
as live input but provides no profitability or prospective-execution evidence.

Protocol references inspected before implementation:
- https://github.com/pump-fun/pump-public-docs/blob/main/docs/PUMP_PROGRAM_README.md
  blob `cdd6e6744c2797e9d502615a84a316cfe97a3ff8`
- https://github.com/pump-fun/pump-public-docs/blob/main/docs/FEE_PROGRAM_README.md
  blob `20b48370e1cc6ac5bdaead8209e369e9b949b362`
- https://github.com/pump-fun/pump-public-docs/blob/main/idl/pump.json
- https://github.com/pump-fun/pump-public-docs/blob/main/idl/pump_fees.json
- https://github.com/solana-program/token-2022/blob/main/interface/src/extension/mod.rs

Account layout decoding is original implementation. No old-repository source,
SDK code, program binaries or production database was imported.
